security_audit.summary: Many static command hits are Markdown examples or normal Linear workflow guidance. Confirmed risks include shell execution, hidden home-directory scripts, and persistent Linear API key storage. I found no prompt injection text or unrelated network destinations beyond Linear services.

remediation.suggestion: Ship referenced helper scripts inside the skill, or remove commands that execute scripts not included in the package.
Use environment-variable references or Varlock only. Remove examples that echo API keys into ~/.claude/.env or place keys inline in MCP config.

remediation.issue: External commands with Linear side effects
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before create, update, comment, or bulk commands. Prefer scoped MCP operations when available.
Convert prohibited secret-printing examples into prose, so agents are less likely to copy and execute them.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when issue updates, project links, and status changes are handled manually. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured Linear workflows using MCP, CLI, and helper-script patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guide issue creation, comments, status updates, and issue listing in Linear.
Describe project and initiative workflows, including linking and lifecycle status changes.
Provide MCP, Linear CLI, helper-script, SDK, and GraphQL usage paths.
Recommend label taxonomy rules and issue-to-project conventions.
Support bulk update planning through direct commands or a Linear-specialist subagent pattern.
limitations: Requires a valid Linear API key or a configured Linear MCP server.
Referenced helper scripts and documentation files must exist in the user environment.
Bulk commands can change many Linear records and should be reviewed before execution.
Does not include the helper script implementations inside the audited package.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Sprint Issue Updates
use_cases.description: Update issue status, add comments, and list assigned work during sprint execution.

use_cases.title: Create Project Plans
use_cases.description: Create projects, add parent issues, create sub-issues, and link work to initiatives.

use_cases.title: Automate Linear Cleanup
use_cases.description: Plan bulk status changes, label checks, and project lifecycle updates after code changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Linear Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my Linear access is ready. Use safe validation steps and do not reveal any API key values.

prompt_templates.title: Create Issues for a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear plan for this feature: [describe feature]. Include a parent issue, sub-issues, labels, and the right project link.

prompt_templates.title: Update Project Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Linear issues: [issue keys]. Move completed work to Done, add a short status comment, and summarize anything blocked.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Bulk Sync Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe bulk Linear sync for these code changes: [change summary]. Include validation, confirmation points, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Create a Linear project plan for a checkout refactor.
output: A project name and initiative link recommendation.
A parent issue with clear acceptance criteria.
A set of sub-issues with labels and suggested starting states.

output_examples.input: Mark ENG-101, ENG-102, and ENG-103 as complete.
output: A confirmation summary of the requested status changes.
A reminder to verify issue identifiers before bulk updates.
A short completion report suitable for a project update.

output_examples.input: Help me check Linear API setup safely.
output_examples.output: The response uses masked validation steps and avoids printing environment values or secret files.

best_practices: Prefer the official Linear MCP server when it is available and configured.
Confirm issue keys, project names, and initiative links before making bulk changes.
Use masked secret validation and avoid printing environment variables.
anti_patterns: Do not print API keys, environment files, or Linear CLI configuration output.
Do not create issues in a holding project and move them later.
Do not run helper scripts from untrusted or unknown workspace paths.

faq.question: What does this skill help manage?
faq.answer: It helps manage Linear issues, projects, initiatives, labels, status updates, and bulk workflow planning.

faq.question: Does it require Linear credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a Linear API key or an authenticated Linear MCP setup.

faq.question: Can it use Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it make changes in Linear?
faq.answer: Yes. Several workflows can create issues, update status, add comments, and change project links.

faq.question: Are helper scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced scripts must be supplied separately.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use masked validation and environment references. Avoid printing keys or writing raw secrets into shared files.
